settingsBilling.cancelSuccessOverLimitNotice: Cancellation submitted. Your current plan stays active until the end of the current billing period. If you're still over the Lieutenant limit at that point, all users will automatically be disconnected from the organization (your data stays fully intact).
settingsBilling.cancelConfirmMessage: Your access stays active until the end of the current billing period. After that, the organization automatically falls back to the free Lieutenant plan (max. 2 vehicles, 5 members).
settingsBilling.cancelConfirmOverLimitTitle: Warning: All users will lose access
settingsBilling.cancelConfirmOverLimitMessage: Your organization currently uses more vehicles or members than the free Lieutenant plan allows (max. 2 vehicles, 5 members). If you cancel and are still over the limit by the end of the billing period, ALL users (including you as owner) will automatically be disconnected from the organization - no one will be able to access it anymore. Your data (vehicles, usage logs, etc.) will NOT be deleted, only access is lost until you subscribe to a suitable plan again.
